site.title: Daniel — Graphic design
site.description: Graphic design portfolio: identity, editorial, packaging and posters.

hero.intro: Identity, editorial, packaging and poster design for brands that prefer to say less, but better.

about.lead: I'm Daniel, a graphic designer with nine years of craft. I believe good design is noticed less than it is felt.
about.text: I work between paper and screen: identity systems, books and magazines, packaging and posters. I always start with questions, sketch by hand, and keep building until everything unnecessary is gone.

process.d: Interviews, references and an honest brief.
Sketches, typography and three distinct directions.
System, grid and refined key pieces.
Files, usage guide and ongoing support.

awards.t: Honorable mention — Latin American Design Biennial

casa-alba.description: Identity system for a boutique hotel in Cartagena: monogram, warm palette and signage.

marea-viva.description: A poster series for a coastal music festival. Simple shapes that move like waves.

tierra-baja.description: A packaging line for single-origin coffee: flat inks on kraft and a modular grid.

revista-umbral.description: Art direction and layout for a quarterly magazine of essays and photography.
revista-umbral.title: Umbral Magazine

olivar.description: Labels and gift box for extra virgin olive oil, with a typographic seal.

pulso.description: Visual identity for a wellness app: pattern system and micro-animations.

noches-de-jazz.description: Season posters for the annual jazz series at Teatro Mayor.
noches-de-jazz.title: Jazz Nights

atlas-de-sal.description: Design for a photo-essay book: cover, interior pages and dust jacket.
atlas-de-sal.title: Salt Atlas
